questions.stem: |A| = 5, |B| = 4 and |A ∩ B| = 2. How many elements are in A ∪ B?
questions.explain: Add the sizes and subtract the overlap that was counted twice: 5 + 4 − 2 = 7.

Resolving the clauses (A ∨ B) and (¬B ∨ C) on B gives which clause?
questions.explain: Resolution cancels the clashing pair B and ¬B and joins what is left: A ∨ C.
